root.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Salvio Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. Bc4 g4 5. Ne5

overview: White sacrifices a pawn with 4.Bc4 g4 5.Ne5 and Black replies 5...Qh4+ 6.Kf1, when White has lost castling but has a large development lead. The play is wild with piece sacrifices for both sides. Theory is rarely played and judged dubious for White.

white_ideas.idea: Use Ne5 and Bc4 against f7 for a quick attack
Open the f-file with the king on f1 and play d4

black_ideas.idea: Develop with ...Nh6 and ...d6 and defend f7
Consolidate extra pawns and counter on the dark squares

typical_structures.structure: Open centre, White king on f1, Black queen out early

character.notes: Wild with early king exposure for White.

gambit.notes: White's f-pawn is gone and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: White's king loses castling for the attack, so it is regarded as dubious.

sublines_that_differ.name: Cochrane Gambit
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. Bc4 g4 5. Ne5 Qh4+ 6. Kf1 f3
sublines_that_differ.how: Black closes the position with a pawn sacrifice.

soundness.reason: White's king is exposed for a risky attack.

plans.reason: White aims at f7 and develops fast.
